vision.name: Hercule
vision.text:
(Your Life Deck cannot include cards that perform energy attacks.)
[Continuous]: Your attacks deal +100 stages of damage. Your attacks cannot have their damage modified by your effects.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
Your MP gains 5 stages. Search your Life Deck for "Hercule's Dynamite Kick" and place it into your hand.
DAMAGE: 1 stage.
vision.note: PZP MP (FanZ Personality layout); right edge reads 'HERO' (no ALLY). Power stages are printed ASCENDING (5 ... 50) above 0; printed design, not a misread
